name: Mount Whitney Trail — Portal to Summit

metadata.description: Whitney Portal to Mt. Whitney summit via the Mount Whitney Trail — the classic east-side approach. Trail line from a GaiaGPS GPX; waypoints snapped to the trail at their known elevations.
metadata.trailhead: Whitney Portal, Inyo National Forest, California
metadata.attribution: Trail: GaiaGPS Mount Whitney known route. Waypoint identity/naming: memoir SVG map. Coordinate cross-checks: Wikipedia, Mountain Project, USGS.

properties.name: Whitney Portal
properties.description: Trailhead. 13.7 miles west of Lone Pine. Camp 1 — the starting point.

properties.name: Outpost Camp
properties.description: 10,365 ft. Camp 3 — used on the descent on day 3.

properties.name: Trail Camp
properties.description: 12,000 ft. Camp 2 — reached after 10.5 hours from the Portal on day 1. Below the 99 switchbacks.

properties.name: Trail Crest
properties.description: 13,600 ft. Highest trail pass in the United States. Sierra Nevada crest — Inyo National Forest ends, Sequoia National Park begins. Top of the 99 switchbacks from Trail Camp.

properties.name: Mt. Whitney Summit
properties.description: 14,505 ft. Highest point in the contiguous United States. Southern terminus of the John Muir Trail. Summit hut (Smithsonian Institution Shelter) with a register.

properties.name: Mount Whitney Trail — real GPS trace
properties.note: Actual trail geometry — includes the 99 switchbacks between Trail Camp and Trail Crest.
